description: bead-groups data for sprint-group: the attach ref and the stage 2 edges the pour cannot make. Endpoints are format strings over {parent}, {ref}, {steps[<step>]}, {vars[<name>]} and, in an `each` edge, {each}. vars: predecessor_sanity (a list: the initial sanity bead of each sprint the plan file names in depends_on).

A.description: E1 option A: only dev is poured; the sanity bead is created when dev closes. Nothing to add after the pour.

B.description: E1 option B: the poured sanity step has no `needs dev`; sanity and QA each `validates` dev.

C.description: E1 option C, the existing schema: sanity `blocks` dev (poured from `needs`) with metadata.dev_bead; QA `validates` the checked bead.

edges.description: the dependent sprint's dev bead blocks on each predecessor's initial sanity bead (hard dependency); an edge to the predecessor's sprint container is added only on the user's request
